reviews.t: Light weight ten point magnets stay on good
reviews.x: First time trying magnet lashes and I think I will thoroughly enjoy these!! I cut one pair in half and placed on outer half of eyes for a more comfortable less dramatic look.  Love that these are reusable and easy to take off and on.

I have used magnetic lashes for several years now. I like the look of these, so I bought them. NEVER AGAIN! I followed the instructions EXACTLY and applied them while the eye liner was still wet. They didn't stick. So, I added more eyeliner, still didn't stick. tried applying when the liner was dry. No stick! By the time I had spent 30 minutes on them, and having eyeliner in many unwanted places, I had to wash my face and start over. I used my other magnetic lashes and they popped right on. Don'

Very thrilled to see 10 magnet lashes here at Amazon. Ever since magnetic liner and lashes have come out I have been thrilled to see how they fit into my eyelash addiction. I started out purchasing a brand that was incredibly expensive I did like them, and the liner was strong . However, the liner was highly expensive. The liner with these lashes had no strength to it at all. Did not hold the lashes on, very unhappy.

My wife loves this kit! She often uses magnetic eyelashes, but all before this had several large chunky magnets. These are super fine and run the entire length of the eyeline. They hold better than the larger ones and look better. Since they are attached to a strip, there is no need to apply extra eyeliner, as the strip gives the same effect! This is a nicely made kit, perfect for storage or as a gift, because the box makes a fine presentation. The lashes are held in place inside the box by magn

Wow! Soooo much better and more secure than the 5 magnet lashes. Alot easier to put on and adjust if needed. Theres natural looking lashes to dramatic length and thickness. My new favorite lash pack! All lashes should be made with 10 magnets on each lash!! These are definitely worth a try on your search for the perfect lashes.

Since the regular magnetic lashes never worked for me I decided to try these. To my surprise they ACTUALLY WORK! The liner goes on like a regular liquid eyeliner then it turns a little tacky when you put the lash on. I can also see the lash magnetically pull to the liner, pretty cool. Removal is easy and the liner comes off with makeup remover just like regular eyelash glue.
A really cool and easy to use product! Super excited to try all of the lash styles available!!

reviews.t: So much better than 5 magnet eyelashes
reviews.x: After trying several of the 5 magnet type, I found these and I'm so glad I did!  The 5 magnet type never worked after I tried to cut them to the right size because there was never a magnet on the end, which made it impossible to get them to stay on without using glue. I found these with 10 smaller magnets and thought I would give them a try! I was able to cut them to the right size and still have magnets on both ends, so they would stay on. I am not very good at applying liquid liner, but I was

Okay, so I tried the Lankiz lashes, and I definitely love them. I put on the extra thick pair from the top row, and honestly can barely feel that I'm wearing them. This is without mascara or other makeup right now,  so please excuse the Snapchat tender heart filter blurring my skin. I picked it because it didn't alter the look of the lashes and my dodgy eyeliner job. :) The magnets hold amazing, the band is thin and the lashes are lightweight.  The tweezers are perfect for putting the lashes on

reviews.t: What a disappointment in these stiff eyelashes - Experienced Eyelash User Here
reviews.x: I've been wearing magnetic eyelashes everyday for over 6 months so I'm pretty experienced.  While I love the 10 magnets and think that's the direction all these systems should be headed, this particular set has many problems.  First the band is very thick and doesn't bend easily to conform to the eye shape.  This would not be that critical if the second problem wasn't so bad.  The second is that the magnetic eyeliner is WORTHLESS!!!  I love the applicator and was so excited to see the felt tip.

This should be 5 stars! The lashes are great and easy to apply and remove, but, buyer beware, both magnetic eyeliners were dried out. I had to buy a different eyeliner just to try these out. Great product if only the eyeliner wasn't unusable!
Eyelashes were so hard to get on and wouldn't stay. The magnetic eyeliner would not apply smoothly. Lashes were stiff and would not curve around eye to stick to eyeliner.
Just opened the sealed box and there is an important piece missing!! The application tweezer thingy is NOT INCLUDED!! What the bleep. T-T

reviews.t: Spend the money on the more expensive brand
reviews.x: They didn't stay on for more than an hour. Then they lifted around the edges
The magnetic lashes dont stick, I would not purchase this item again.

I was immediately impressed with the packaging and presentation of this magnetic lash kit.  It was packaged nicely.  Comes with five pairs of 10 magnet lashes, an applicator, and two tubes of magnetic liner.  The lashes are nice, but a little too dramatic for my liking as they are.  I plan on trimming some and applying to the outer half of my eye to see if I can achieve a less dramatic, more comfortable look.  The applicator is a really good quality. reviews.x: I’ve never used lashes before this, I’m talking 0 experience. My first attempt I won’t lie , I got frustrated and gave up. The lashes wouldn’t stick and were too long . I instead of just reading the directions, I went straight to YouTube and watched a couple of tutorials. I’m a hands on , visual learner. My advice just read the directions. Second attempt I trimmed lash to fit mine and this time did not let the liner dry (the the directions said) and just like that I’m a new woman ! 😎 Also easy t

(I use magnetic lashes almost every day and never had one, but be safe.) The eyeliner needs 2-3 coats to stick well otherwise they do not hold. The band is very stiff and I personally don’t enjoy that. I highly recommend trimming them down, as they’re a lot easier to manage. Even if you cut the lashes

I own a hair salon and highly recommend these lashes to all my clients. I apply them to most clients. Maybe my little tricks might help you. I highly recommend this product.  For myself personally, I like to cut my lashes in half for daytime makeup. Cutting these lashes is fine because there are plenty of magnets.  Ladies, lashes are not 1 size fits all so gently and Modestly trim the inside edge(side closest to your nose) of your eyelash to fit to a size best for you.  The magnets stay firmly f

Absolutely love this! I’ve never worn lashes except for once when I had them professionally done. I didn’t enjoy that because it wasn’t comfortable to sleep with & I don’t like the idea of glue and fumes around my eyes. These however are soo easy to put on & remove. Liner is easy to apply as well. I normally have trouble with liquid liner but this was very precise and easy. Will be purchasing again!

reviews.t: Nice lashes, old dried out liner
reviews.x: 3 stars because the magnetic liners are a little dried out and difficult to apply. The lashes are nice and the variety is good but what good are they if the liner is almost unusable? I had to use magnetic liner from another brand I already had.

I own a lot of different eyelashes I love these the most. They are easy to put on the packaging was nice, the directions are easy to follow and they stay on all day. I will be recommending these to my friends.

They are very hard to use. I kept having to put on the eye liner and lashes wouldn’t stick in the corners at all. And it was windy that day and my eye lashes looked like they were getting ready to take flight.
Horrible!!!!  Both tubes of liner were dried up...yes, I shook the tubes until my hand was numb.  The lashes were not good quality either.  I DO NOT recommend this product!!
The only problem I have is that they are very stiff. In turn that means they come lose from the magnetic liner.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the 10-magnet design holds better and is easier to apply than 5-magnet lashes.
Several reviewers say the lashes are easy to apply and remove and feel lightweight.
A common complaint is that the lashes do not stick or stay on, often tied to the liner.
Some reviewers report problems with the eyeliner, including it being dried out or not applying smoothly.
A few reviewers mention the lash band is stiff and hard to curve to the eye.
